name: LibreCrate
tagline: Private offline vault for your documents and notes
blurb: LibreCrate is a private, offline vault for your documents.
description:
LibreCrate is a private, offline vault for your documents. Store PDFs, ebooks, boarding passes and wallet cards, comics, photos, and notes — all safely locked away and organized.

Everything you save is encrypted on your device and protected by a password you set. Nobody can read your files without you. LibreCrate never connects to the internet, so your documents never leave your phone.

Features:

• Store PDFs, EPUBs, Apple Wallet passes, CBZ comics, images, and notes

• Everything stays encrypted on your device, protected by your password

• Built-in PDF reader with pinch-to-zoom and smooth scrolling

• Search your library, including the text inside documents

• Sort and filter to keep your library tidy

• Add files easily — share to LibreCrate or pick them from your phone

• Back up and restore your vault as one encrypted file

• Use on multiple devices — restore your backup on another phone, tablet, or computer

• Fully offline — no account, no tracking, no ads
